responsibility: Implements GCC’s sanitizer-coverage pass for fuzzing-oriented instrumentation, inserting callbacks that report control-flow and comparison behavior to the SanitizerCoverage runtime. At GIMPLE level it adds per-basic-block trace_pc hooks, instruments integer and floating-point comparisons with the size-specific __sanitizer_cov_trace_cmp* or const_cmp* builtins, lowers switch statements into trace_switch calls with synthesized static case tables, and provides the normal and -O0 pass variants gated by sanitize_coverage_p.
